title: Layer Normalization
authors: J. Ba, J. Kiros, G. Hinton
before: Batch normalisation stabilised training but depended on batch statistics.
problem: Batch statistics are awkward for variable-length sequences and small batches.
breakthrough: Normalise across the features of each example independently of the batch.
why: The other half of the transformer block's plumbing. Pre-norm placement is what makes deep stacks trainable.
next: Used in the Transformer, then moved before each sublayer in GPT-2.
inherits: The normalisation layer inside every transformer block.
